exceptions.reason: The advisory requires SSE with rendered view fragments. This application uses SseEmitter with JSON event data and has no FragmentsRendering usage. No public 6.2 patch was available at review time; upgrading to Spring 7 is a separate migration.

The advisory requires XsltView rendering with a wildcard controller mapping and an implicit view name. Backend endpoints return REST/JSON and SSE data; the application has no XsltView or XsltViewResolver configuration. No public 6.2 patch was available at review time.
